ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Visible area contains approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels and 35% low-intensity black pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity (black) central contiguous region extending from the peduncle base to the median notch. High-intensity (white) pixels occupy the majority of the lateral lobes, interrupted by black linear disruptions on the left lobe and a singular dark circular focal cluster on the upper right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped indentation with a vertex angle of approximately 68 degrees; vertical depth occupies ~12% of the total fluke height in the image plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing boundary with continuous jagged serrations. Left lobe exhibits higher amplitude peaks (10-20 pixels) than the right, which shows more localized, deep narrow notches near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve fitted to the trailing edge sweep from the median notch vertex to the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Group of ~8 low-intensity circular pixel clusters localized at the far-left distal tip; one distinct, high-contrast circular anomaly located on the mid-upper right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of four roughly parallel, low-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) traversing the white pigmentation of the left lobe diagonally from bottom-center toward the upper-left margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel rake marks on the left ventral lobe and a distinct circular focal scar on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Transition zone between central black and lateral white pigmentation shows high-frequency, fine-scale 'bleeding' or speckling rather than a sharp geometric boundary.
